"1. Connect powered-on N3 goggles to your phone with a USB data cable. Keep Neo and RC3 linked by radio, not USB.

2. Close DJI Fly. Select N3 Manual in the USB app chooser and grant Android USB permission. If Fly always opens, clear its USB default in Android app settings.

3. Tap Connect and test USB. Once the menu responds, run step 1. Look inside the goggles and use step 2 only when the right Confirm button is selected.

4. On error, use Show USB status and save a report. Both Android Accessory over C–C and USB-host/OTG are supported. USB debugging is not required.

5. Change settings on the ground with propellers removed and motors off. Check the M assignment in the goggles before flying. This app does not freeze settings or repair firmware.

Language / Język: System (automatic), English or Polski. The installer and Android USB dialogs use Android's own language. App language does not change the goggles menu language."

"N3 Manual %1$s
Author: Grzegorz Staszczyk
MIT license

Independent menu tool for Goggles N3 + Neo + FPV Remote Controller 3. Not affiliated with DJI. Other sets are unverified.

No Internet, account, camera or microphone access. The report stays in memory and is saved only when you select a file. It includes phone model, Android version and USB diagnostics, without the phone serial number.

Emulator tests cover app compatibility, not physical USB. After use, verify the Manual assignment in the goggles.

Language: follows the system by default (Polish for Polish, English otherwise); you can override it in Language / Język.

LogicLink format: third-eye, William Robinet, MIT."
